mapper.select: SELECT id, photo_id, item_label, url, title, note, sort_order FROM product_link WHERE photo_id = #{photoId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_link (photo_id, item_label, url, title, note, sort_order) SELECT #{photoId}, #{itemLabel}, #{url}, #{title}, #{note}, COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM product_link WHERE photo_id = #{photoId}
